title: Svenska Kraftnät NUP — per-region connection queue snapshot
description: One record per Svenska Kraftnät region. Reports requested capacity in the connection queue as of September 2025 per region per side (inmatning = production injection requests, uttag = consumption draw requests). Source: NUP §4.6 figures (Figur 6/8/10/12/14/16/18/20/23/25/27/29). MW values are read from bar charts in the source; bar-chart axes do not have fine gridlines, so values are approximate and tagged with confidence_tier='estimated'. For the cell-feasibility model, per-region queue size is one input to the buildability gate at region scope.

region_name.description: Source-published region name in original Swedish (e.g. 'Region Norrbotten', 'Regionerna Sörmland och Östergötland').

bidding_zones.description: Bidding zones the region overlaps (per §4.6 narrative).

production_request_mw_estimated.description: Inmatning bar height in MW, read from chart. Null if too small to read.

consumption_request_mw_estimated.description: Uttag bar height in MW, read from chart. Null if too small to read.

queue_pattern.description: Qualitative pattern. _heavy = at least one side > 5000 MW. _moderate = both sides 500-5000 MW. balanced = sides within 30% of each other and both > 500 MW. small_queue = both < 500 MW.

narrative_note.description: Free-text English context, especially flagging regions where the source narrative explicitly notes capacity shortage (kapacitetsbrist) or that current capacity is insufficient.
